Welcome to Dr. Patt Exotic Vet — your trusted source for expert care of exotic pets, birds, reptiles, amphibians, small mammals, and traditional pets like dogs and cats. I’m Dr. Patt, an exotic veterinarian with more than 25 years of clinical experience helping pets and educating owners, technicians, and veterinary students.

Here you’ll find practical care tips, case studies, training insights, and behind-the-scenes moments from Little Critters Veterinary Hospital. My goal is to help you understand your pet’s needs, prevent health problems, and feel confident in providing the best care possible.

Explore detailed pet care guides at www.littlecrittersvet.com
 and subscribe for new educational videos every week!
